- Sales posture: account is effectively stalled — procurement placed a hold 2/05/2025. No legal docs out. AE recommended a light-touch lifecycle: quarterly check-ins, keep security artifacts updated, offer a 6-month POC extension at no additional cost.
- Notes on champion: Previously strong champion (Head of Data Eng) is on an internal hiring pause and has deprioritized the initiative. No clear alternate champion identified.
- Suggested content to keep warm: 1) updated SOC2 + architecture note, 2) cost-savings modeling for dedicated vs hosted for their request volume, 3) reference case for claims triage in regulated environment.
- Quote from CTO on 2025-02-12 call: "We like the tech but we simply can't add new platform spend until the hiring freeze lifts."
